item.title: Park Min-sik Meets Han Dong-hoon at Bean Noodle Soup Service, Says "He’s Not Worth Uniting With" (콩국수 봉사서 만난 박민식, 한동훈 향해 “단일화 상대 안 돼”)
item.description:
On the 21st, the first day of official campaigning for the June 3 by-election, candidates engaged in a three-way race for the Busan North Gap National Assembly by-election gathered in one place. (6·3 재보궐선거 공식 선거 운동이 시작된 21일, 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 3파전을 벌이고 있는 후보들이 한자리에 모였다.)

Ha Jung-woo of the Democratic Party of Korea, Park Min-sik of the People Power Party, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon participated as volunteers at a "Bean Noodle Soup Sharing Event" held that morning at the Nam San-jeong Comprehensive Social Welfare Center in Buk-gu, Busan. <<>/> Ha, who arrived first, entered the kitchen and shook hands individually with volunteers, greeting them. He said, "I’ll work hard," and "I’ll bring a lot of state funds like my brother Jaesu and support you," as he served noodles to residents. <<>/> Han appeared next, exchanging handshakes and greetings with residents. When a supporter shouted, "Han Dong-hoon, fighting!" he raised his hand in response. Park, who arrived last, bowed to residents before joining the food serving. Han offered a handshake to Park, greeting him. <<>/> After the service, when asked by reporters about conservative unification, Park said, "I don’t see Han as a partner for unification. He’s someone who inflicted an indelible wound on the conservative camp and should prostrate himself in apology. Engineering unification through elections would be a betrayal of Buk-gu residents." <<>/> Han told reporters, "Conservatives can never take power with politics that defends martial law and takes an ambiguous stance on impeachment. With my capabilities and resolve, I can make this heated Buk-gu the center of Busan and the center of South Korea." <<>/> During a prior campaign launch, Ha said, "What politics, ideology, or faction does the name 'Buk-gu' carry? If you want to brawl, go to Seoul. I’ll work until my body breaks down, burying my bones in Buk-gu. Trust me and leave it to me—I’ll get it done." <<>/> Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (하정우 더불어민주당 후보와 박민식 국민의힘 후보, 한동훈 무소속 후보는 이날 오전 부산 북구 남산정종합사회복지관에서 열린 ‘콩국수 나눔 행사’에 봉사자로 참석했다.)

item.title: DP: "Making an alibi for election defeat?... 'Election fraud season 2' trick is obvious" (민주 “선거 패배 알리바이 만드나…‘부정선거 시즌2’ 꼼수 뻔해”)
item.description:
After the People Power Party announced plans to establish a "Fair Election Safe Voting Committee" citing concerns among its supporters about vote management, the Democratic Party criticized it, saying, "Are you making an alibi for defeat from the start of the election?" (국민의힘이 투표 관리에 대한 지지층의 불안감을 이유로 ‘공명선거 안심투표위원회’ 설치 방침을 밝히자, 더불어민주당이 “선거 시작부터 패배 알리바이나 만들 생각인가”라고 비판했다.)

Democratic Party spokesperson Kim Hyun-jung said this in a written briefing on the 21st, stating, "The People Power Party said it would establish a 'Fair Election Safe Voting Committee.' I suspect that election fraud theorists have all rallied to the People Power Party." (김현정 민주당 대변인은 21일 서면 브리핑에서 “국민의힘이 ‘공명선거 안심투표위원회’를 설치한다고 밝혔다. 부정선거론자들이 국민의힘에 총집결한 것은 아닌지 의심된다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Regarding the People Power Party's explanation that it does not "condone election fraud," Spokesperson Kim criticized, "Their shabby intention to create an alibi for defeat through election fraud conspiracy theories is so obvious that they're making excuses on their own without even being asked." (김 대변인은 “부정선거에 동조하는 것은 아니”라는 국민의힘의 설명을 두고 “부정선거 음모론으로 패배 알리바이를 만들겠다는 얄팍한 속내가 너무나 뻔히 보이니, 묻지도 않았는데 스스로 변명부터 하는 꼴”이라고 비판했다.)

She added, "'Election fraud season 1,' led by Yoon Suk-yeol, led to the disastrous result of impeachment. Even if they try to pull off a trick to create 'election fraud season 2' again related to this election, the result will be the same," and "How about thinking about winning by running a good campaign instead of making an 'alibi for election defeat'?" (이어 “윤석열을 필두로 한 ‘부정선거 시즌1’은 탄핵이라는 처참한 결과로 이어졌다. 이번 선거와 관련해 또다시 ‘부정선거 시즌2’를 만들겠다는 꼼수를 부려봤자 결과는 마찬가지일 것”이라며 “‘선거 패배 알리바이’나 만들 생각 말고, 선거 운동 잘해서 이길 생각부터 하는 게 어떤가”라고 덧붙였다.)

People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon met with reporters after the Central Election Strategy Committee meeting held at the National Assembly the previous day and announced the establishment of the Fair Election Safe Voting Committee, chaired by Supreme Council Member Shin Dong-wook. (박성훈 국민의힘 수석대변인은 전날 국회에서 열린 중앙선거대책위원회 회의 뒤 기자들을 만나 신동욱 최고위원을 위원장으로 하는 공명선거 안심투표위원회를 설치하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Spokesperson Park said, "There are some who think about election fraud, and we do not agree with that logic, but it is true that there is anxiety among the People Power Party's supporters about vote management," adding, "It reflects our will for the People Power Party to take the lead in thoroughly safeguarding the management of both main voting and early voting." The committee plans to operate CCTV observation teams at early polling stations and ballot storage locations. Spokesperson Park added, "We will also thoroughly monitor any potential illegal elections or government-backed elections by the ruling party," and "We also plan activities to encourage early voting." (박 대변인은 “일각에서 부정선거라고 생각하는 분들이 계시고 저희는 그런 논리에 동조하지는 않지만, 투표 관리에 대해 국민의힘 지지층에서 불안감이 있는 건 사실”이라며 “본투표와 사전투표 관리를 국민의힘이 나서서 철저히 지켜나가겠다는 의지를 담았다”고 말했다. 위원회는 사전투표소와 투표용지 보관 장소 등에 폐회로텔레비전(CCTV) 참관단을 운영할 예정이다. 박 대변인은 “혹시 있을지 모르는 정부 여당의 불법선거, 관권선거도 철저히 감시하겠다”며 “사전투표를 독려하기 위한 활동도 진행할 계획”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, after the debate on 'election fraud conspiracy theories' between Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok and far-right YouTuber Jeon Han-gil held in February, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk had stated on Facebook, "Regardless of the truth of election fraud, many citizens believe that already revealed issues such as granting voting rights to foreigners or poor management of early voting should be corrected," and "We will form a task force at the party level to ensure thorough election monitoring." In response, the Reform Party reacted, saying, "Representative Jang, who parasitizes election fraud delusions, is a cancer cell eating away at conservatism" (Senior Spokesperson Lee Dong-hoon). (앞서 장동혁 대표는 지난 2월 진행된 이준석 개혁신당 대표와 극우 유튜버 전한길씨의 ‘부정선거 음모론’ 토론회 뒤 페이스북에서 “많은 국민들은 부정선거의 진위 여부를 떠나 외국인 투표권 부여나 사전투표 관리 부실 등 이미 드러난 문제점들을 바로잡아야 한다고 생각한다”며 “철저한 선거 감시가 이뤄지도록 당 차원의 티에프(TF)를 구성하겠다”고 밝힌 바 있다. 그러자 개혁신당에서는 “부정선거 망상에 기생하는 장 대표는 보수를 좀먹는 암세포”(이동훈 수석대변인)라는 반응이 나왔었다.)

Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Yoo Si-min: “The Yeongnam region sees a competitive race between the Democratic Party and the People Power Party – this kind of election is unprecedented in our political history.” (유시민 “영남 지역서 민주-국힘 경합, 이런 선거 우리 정치 역사상 처음”)
item.description:
Writer Yoo Si-min said about the June 3 local elections, “The fact that the entire Yeongnam area has become a competitive region (between the Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party) is the first time in our political history.” <<> Appearing on YouTube’s “Kim Eo-jun’s Humility is Difficult News Factory” on the 21st, Yoo stated, “From the Democratic Party’s perspective, Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang (Bukyung) have shifted from being a region where we were trailing in competition to a truly competitive region. Now, it’s impossible to predict who will win.” He added, “Previously, it was a 51:49 game (People Power Party vs. Democratic Party), but now Bukyung has become a completely 50:50 election. Daegu and North Gyeongsang have moved from being a region of absolute disadvantage (for the Democratic Party) to one of competitive disadvantage.” <<> Recent opinion poll results indeed highlight the intense competition in the Bukyung region. <<> According to a survey commissioned by the JoongAng Ilbo and conducted by K-Stat Research from the 17th to the 19th, targeting 804 men and women aged 18 and over in Busan via mobile phone interviews, regarding the Busan mayoral election—where Democratic Party candidate Jae-soo Jeon is facing off against People Power Party candidate Hyeong-joon Park—Jeon received 42% support, while Park garnered 35%. <<> In the same survey for the Busan Buk-gu by-election for a National Assembly seat, Democratic Party candidate Jeong-woo Ha received 35%, independent candidate Dong-hoon Han 31%, and People Power Party candidate Min-sik Park 20%. In a similar survey for the Daegu mayoral election, targeting 801 men and women in Daegu, Democratic Party candidate Bu-gyeom Kim received 41% and People Power Party candidate Gyeong-ho Chu 38%, showing a tight race within the margin of error. <<> The sampling error for these surveys is a maximum of ±3.5 percentage points at a 95% confidence level for the Busan and Daegu mayoral elections, and a maximum of ±4.4 percentage points at a 95% confidence level for the Busan Buk-gu election. For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Committee. <<> Yoo assessed, “Overall, the change in the political landscape first confirmed during the 2016 general election—where the Democratic Party took the No. 1 party symbol—is becoming more entrenched. I think this June 3 election further confirms that trend.” <<> Speaking about the by-election for the Pyeongtaek (Buk-gu) National Assembly seat, Yoo commented, “This election shows what has happened in Korean politics over the past few years, what is happening now, and what meaning these events will have for us in the future.” In Pyeongtaek Buk-gu, candidates include Democratic Party’s Yong-nam Kim, Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, and People Power Party’s Eui-dong Yoo. <<> Yoo noted that Cho Kuk is “originally a person from the Democratic Party,” while “the Democratic Party candidate is someone who came from that other party”—referring to Kim’s background in the Saenuri Party and Cho’s tenure as Minister of Justice under the Moon Jae-in administration. Yoo added, “President Jae-myung Lee has pursued a purposeful strategy of expanding to the center and to the right, starting from his candidacy, and this has led to such a phenomenon for the first time. It means that while the People Power Party lineage used to be the mainstream party, the Democratic Party is now the mainstream party.” <<> Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (유시민 작가가 6·3 지방선거를 두고 “영남이 전체적으로 (더불어민주당과 국민의힘의) 경합 지역이 된 것은 우리 정치 역사에서 처음이다”라고 말했다.)

item.title: On first day of campaigning, Jang Dong-hyuk and Jeong Cheong-rae engage in verbal sparring: "Let's shout" (선거운동 첫날 장동혁, 정청래 지나가자 “소리 지르자” 신경전)
item.description:
On the 21st, the first day of official campaigning for the June 3 local and by-elections, Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, and Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, crossed paths in South Chungcheong Province, where approval ratings are narrowing. Jang ran into Jeong while giving a campaign speech at the Gongju Sanseong Market, as Jeong was also greeting voters in the market. <<> On the afternoon of that day, Jang visited Sanseong Market to support Chungnam Governor candidate Kim Tae-heum, Gongju Mayor candidate Choi Won-cheol, and Gongju-Buyeo-Cheongyang National Assembly candidate Yoon Yong-geun. Climbing onto a campaign vehicle, he said, "I saw the Democratic Party campaigning on the way; there were about a dozen people in blue clothes. All the folks from Gongju are here." This was a jab suggesting that the crowd supporting Park Su-hyeon, the Democratic Party's Chungnam governor candidate, who was also campaigning at the same time, was small. <<> As Jeong passed by Jang's campaign vehicle, Jang urged the People Power Party campaigners, "Let's shout once," leading them to cheer for the People Power Party candidates. The People Power Party supporters shouted at Jeong, "Oppose the withdrawal of the indictment" and "Oppose the cancellation of the trial." Jang then said, "This is so the Democratic Party leader and their candidate can hear it as they pass by. I was going to keep it quiet since Gongju is a city of gentlemen, but they just had to walk right here while we were giving a speech." <<> For a moment, both leaders stayed in the same place at the same time, with Democratic Party campaigners in blue and People Power Party campaigners in red walking together. Some Democratic Party campaigners in blue asked to take photos with Jang and cheered for him. <<> Jang toured the market, making eye contact and greeting individual citizens. Reactions from the public were mixed. At the Daejeon Jungang Market, one merchant showed support by saying, "I don't want to live in a communist country. What should I do?" On the other hand, a citizen grabbed Jang's hand and gave him blunt advice: "You need to unite with Han Dong-hoon," or "Do better. The public sentiment isn't simple. People say you're not communicating." <<> Attending the "Daejeon Citizens' Victory Launch Ceremony" at Daejeon Station, Jang introduced himself as "a son of Daejeon, a son of Chungcheong" and said, "I started my planning here in Daejeon, who gave me love without expecting anything in return, so I began my first schedule here." He added, "If Daejeon wins, the People Power Party wins nationwide. Let's raise the People Power Party's approval rating by 1% every day." <<> Jang's decision to spend the first day of campaigning in the Chungcheong region is interpreted as a strategy to win in South Chungcheong, where recent approval ratings are tightening. In a poll conducted by NewsPim and Realmeter on the 18th-19th among 806 residents of South Chungcheong aged 18 and older using an automated response method, Democratic Party candidate Park Su-hyeon had 43.5%, while People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-heum had 43.9%. This shows a close race within the margin of error of ±3.5 percentage points. (For more details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website.) <<> Gongju, South Chungcheong/Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거와 재보궐선거 공식 선거운동이 시작된 21일 정청래 더불어민주당 대표와 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 최근 지지율이 좁혀지고 있는 충남에서 마주쳤다. 장 대표가 충남 공주 산성시장에서 지원유세를 하던 중 정 대표도 시장에서 인사를 돌다가 조우한 것이다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-nam "Not running for president"... Cho Kuk "Choose the person, not the party" (김용남 “대선 출마 안 해”…조국 “정당보다 인물을”)
item.description:
In Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi Province, a by-election district where candidate unification has emerged as a major variable, five candidates from ruling and opposition parties heated up the election on the 21st by campaigning across the area. (국회의원 재선거 지역이자 단일화가 최대 변수로 떠오른 경기 평택을에서는 21일 여야 후보 5명이 지역 곳곳에서 유세에 나서며 선거를 뜨겁게 달궜다.)

Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, visited the Pyeongtaek Port container terminal early in the morning to meet port workers on the night shift. In the afternoon, he held a campaign kickoff rally at Anjung Market, saying, "There is so much to do for the Pyeongtaek-eul district. I have no intention of running for president right after being elected, unlike some people, and I won't serve three terms with nothing to show for it, unlike some other candidates." This was a pointed remark aimed at Cho Kuk, leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, and Yoo Ui-dong of the People Power Party, who served three terms as a lawmaker in Pyeongtaek. <<> Yoo also held a campaign kickoff rally at Anjung Market, promoting his "local worker" image. He asked, "Can you trust the pledges from someone who hasn't even lived in Pyeongtaek for a month?" and declared, "The person to entrust with Pyeongtaek's future must be someone who truly knows the area." He began his election campaign at midnight at Pyeongtaek Seojeong-ri Station. <<> Cho Kuk started his campaign by paying respects at the Pyeongtaek Memorial Tower and held a kickoff rally at the planned site for the KTX Gyeonggi Southern Station in Haechang-ri. He said, "This time, please choose the person, not the party," and added, "Once I enter the National Assembly, I will immediately take action for the solidarity and integration of the democratic reform camp." <<> Kim Jae-yeon, the Progressive Party candidate, began her campaign with a morning rally in front of Samsung Semiconductor's Pyeongtaek campus at 7 a.m., and held a kickoff rally at the Godeok Rodeo Square that evening. Hwang Kyo-ahn, the Liberty and Innovation candidate, visited the SPL Pyeongtaek plant and attended a sports festival for disabled Korean-American youth. <<> In Pyeongtaek-eul, Kim Yong-nam, Cho Kuk, and Yoo Ui-dong are forming a three-way race. item.title: Park Min-shik Shaves Head at Rally, Declares "No Unification with Han Dong-hoon – That's a 'Hot Iced Americano'" (박민식, 출정식서 삭발 “한동훈과의 단일화는 ‘뜨거운 아아’”)
item.description:

At a campaign rally held at the Ssambawi Park in Busan's Gupo Market, Park shaved his head and declared, "There will be no unification. I will go all the way and win." He directed his remarks at independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, saying, "Who is this intruder who suddenly flew into our Buk-gu and tries to act like the master? He continued, "The moment we accept Han Dong-hoon, we complete the path of Han Dong-hoon's style of conservative devastation, plundering of Buk-gu, and parasitism on the Democratic Party," and reiterated, "The idea of unifying conservatism with Han Dong-hoon is a delusion that cannot exist, like a 'hot iced Americano.'" <<> By Jang Na-rae, reporter wing@hani.co.kr ( 박 후보는 이날 부산 구포시장 쌈지공원에서 열린 출정식에서 “단일화는 없다. 끝까지 가서 반드시 이긴다”며 삭발을 했다. 그는 한동훈 무소속 후보를 향해 “지금 우리 북구에 느닷없이 날아와 주인 노릇을 하려는 침입자가 누구냐”라며 “이명박 대통령을 구속시키고, 박근혜 대통령을 사법의 칼날 앞에 세우고, 윤석열 대통령에 등을 돌려 정권을 무너뜨린 잔인한 배신자”라고 말했다. )

item.title: 'Rescue Ship Seized' 2 Koreans Return on 22nd… Israel Deports Without Detention (‘구호선 나포’ 한국인 2명 22일 귀국…이스라엘, 구금 않고 추방)
item.description:
Two South Korean activists who were seized by Israeli forces after participating in the Gaza aid flotilla and subsequently released without detention are expected to arrive on the 22nd, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. (가자구호선단에 참여했다가 이스라엘군에 나포된 이후 구금 없이 석방된 한국인 활동가 2명이 22일 도착할 예정이라고 외교부가 밝혔다.)

Deputy Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Park Il stated at a regular briefing on the 21st that "Israel seized at sea a ship carrying two of our nationals who participated in the Gaza aid flotilla, forcefully escorted them to Israel on the 20th, and deported them to a third country within hours," adding that "they will arrive in South Korea on the morning of the 22nd via a third country." The two are expected to board a flight from Bangkok, Thailand, to Incheon, arriving at Incheon International Airport at 6:20 a.m. on the 22nd. (박일 외교부 대변인은 21일 정례브리핑에서 “이스라엘은 가자지구 구호선단에 참여했던 우리 국민 2명이 탑승한 선박을 해상에서 나포하고 20일 이스라엘로 압송한 뒤 수시간 만에 제3국으로 추방했다”며 “(이들은) 제3국을 경유해 22일 오전 한국에 도착할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 이들은 타이(태국) 방콕에서 인천행 비행기를 타고 22일 새벽 6시20분 인천국제공항에 도착할 것으로 보인다.)

Park explained the circumstances of their release, saying, "Before and after the ship carrying our nationals was seized, the government repeatedly requested at various levels that our nationals be immediately released and deported without detention, prioritizing their safety above all else. The Israeli side considered this and specifically explained that the two Korean nationals would be deported directly without passing through detention facilities." International criticism grew as it became known that the Israeli government had detained activists from about 20 countries participating in the flotilla, subjecting them to harsh treatment such as making them kneel and press their heads to the ground. However, it is reported that only four people, including the two Korean nationals, were released without such detention or harsh treatment. (박 대변인은 “정부는 우리 국민의 탑승 선박이 나포되기 전후로 각급에서 여러 차례에 걸쳐 우리 국민의 안전을 최우선적으로 고려해 구금 없이 즉각 석방 및 추방되도록 해줄 것을 요청했다. 이스라엘 쪽은 이를 감안해 특별히 한국 국민 2명은 구금시설을 거치지 않고 바로 추방할 것이라고 설명했다”며 이들의 석방 경위를 전했다. 당시 이스라엘 정부가 선단에 참여한 20여개국 활동가들을 구금해 무릎을 꿇리고 머리를 바닥에 박게 하는 등 가혹 행위를 한 것이 알려지면서 국제사회의 규탄이 커졌다. 다만 우리 국민 2명을 포함한 4명만 이러한 구금이나 가혹 행위 없이 풀려난 것으로 전해졌다.)

Earlier, on the 18th, the rescue ship 'Kyriakos X,' carrying Korean activist Kim Dong-hyun, was seized by the Israeli navy in international waters of the Mediterranean Sea off Cyprus. Two days later, on the 20th, Korean activist Haecho (28, Kim A-hyun), affiliated with the 'Korea Headquarters for the Voyage to Liberate Palestine,' was also captured by Israeli forces while departing from Italy on the ship 'Lina Al Nabulsi' heading toward Gaza. Haecho had previously participated in a Gaza flotilla in October last year, was seized and detained by Israeli forces, and was released after receiving consular assistance. Afterward, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs became aware of Haecho's plans to rejoin the flotilla and invalidated her passport for reasons of national safety. In response, Spokesperson Park stated regarding Haecho, whose passport had been invalidated, that "we provided a travel certificate to ensure no issues with her return." (앞서 지난 18일 한국인 활동가 김동현씨가 탑승한 구호선 ‘키리아코스 엑스(X)’호는 키프로스 지중해 공해상에서 이스라엘 해군에 나포됐다. 이틀 뒤인 20일 ‘팔레스타인 해방을 위한 항해 한국본부’ 소속 한국인 활동가 해초(28·김아현)씨도 ‘리나 알 나불시’호를 타고 이탈리아에서 출항해 가자지구로 향하다가 이스라엘군에 붙잡혔다. 해초는 지난해 10월 처음으로 가자지구 선단에 참여했다가 이스라엘군에 의해 나포·구금된 뒤 영사 조력을 받고 석방된 바 있다. 외교부는 이후 해초가 다시 선단에 참여할 계획을 인지한 뒤, 국민 안전을 이유로 여권 무효화 조처를 했다. 이에 박 대변인은 여권이 무효가 된 해초에 대해 “여행증명서를 전달해 귀국에 문제가 없도록 지원했다”고 말했다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs maintains that it could take further passport invalidation measures if other nationals attempt to enter Gaza in the future. Civil society has criticized this, arguing that fundamentally blocking departures for the realization of peace and humanitarianism constitutes a violation of fundamental rights. However, a ministry official stated, "Our principle remains to prioritize the protection of citizens' lives, and while we will review what can be done institutionally, the principle will remain unchanged," indicating that the passport invalidation measures will continue. Currently, the Lawyers for a Democratic Society are pursuing the main administrative lawsuit to revoke the order to surrender Haecho's passport. (외교부는 이후에도 우리 국민이 가자지구 진입을 시도할 경우 여권 무효화 조치를 또 취할 수 있다는 입장이다. 평화와 인도주의 실현을 위한 출국을 원천적으로 봉쇄하는 건 국가의 기본권 침해라는 시민사회 비판도 나오고 있다. 그러나 외교부 당국자는 “저희의 원칙은 국민 생명 보호를 그대로 유지한다는 것이고, 제도적으로 할 수 있는 부분을 검토해보겠지만 원칙은 그대로 유지될 것”이라며 여권 무효화 조치는 유지될 것이라고 밝혔다. 현재 민주사회를위한변호사모임은 해초에 대한 여권 반납 명령을 취소해 달라는 행정소송 본안을 진행하고 있다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Woo Sang-ho: "Gangneung Data Center Attraction Confirmed... Will Create Hope for Jobs in Gangwon" (우상호 “강릉 데이터센터 유치 확정…강원에 일자리 희망 만들겠다”)
item.description:
"I will create a sense of pride in living in Gangwon Province, and hope that even in Gangwon, one can land a job at a large corporation." (“강원도에 산다는 자부심, 강원도에서도 대기업에 취직할 수 있다는 희망을 만들겠다.”)

Woo Sang-ho, the Democratic Party of Korea's candidate for Gangwon Governor in the June 3 local elections, who served as the first chief presidential secretary for political affairs under the Lee Jae-myung administration, met with The Hankyoreh at the National Assembly on the 19th, highlighting his pledge to 'build an AI data center in Gangneung' and speaking as above. He repeatedly emphasized that this is not just a typical rosy campaign promise from the political sphere, but an actual plan that has concluded consultations with the corporate side. Candidate Woo also lashed out at Kim Jin-tae, the People Power Party's candidate for Gangwon Governor, who has criticized Woo for his low understanding of the region, asking, "Did the person who knows Gangwon well ruin Gangwon's economy like that?" (이재명 정부 첫 청와대 정무수석을 지낸 6·3 지방선거 우상호 더불어민주당 강원지사 후보는 지난 19일 국회에서 한겨레와 만나 ‘강릉 에이아이(AI·인공지능) 데이터센터 구축’ 공약을 부각하며 이렇게 말했다. 정치권의 흔한 장밋빛 공약이 아닌, 기업 쪽과 협의를 마친 실제 계획이란 점도 거듭 강조했다. 우 후보는 지역 이해도가 낮다고 비판하는 김진태 국민의힘 강원지사 후보를 향해 “강원도를 잘 아는 사람이 강원도 경제를 그렇게 망쳤느냐”고 일갈했다.)

―On the 15th, you announced the successful attraction of an AI data center at the launch ceremony of your election campaign committee. (―지난 15일 선거대책위원회 출범식에서 에이아이 데이터센터 유치 성공을 발표했다.)

"We have requested investment in Gangwon Province from one of the top five domestic companies and have been consulting with them. Senior executives of that company came to Chuncheon for direct consultations. We plan to build an AI data center through investments of at least 20 trillion won up to a maximum of 70 trillion won over the next 10 years. We estimate that this will create over 200,000 jobs, including in related industries. We will redraw the industrial map of Gangwon. The Yeongdong region has abundant water and electricity. Gangneung is truly the optimal location for a large-scale AI data center." (“국내 5대 기업 중 한곳에 강원도에 대한 투자를 요청하고 협의해왔다. 해당 기업 고위층이 춘천에 와서 직접 협의하기도 했다. 향후 10년간 최소 20조원에서 최대 70조원의 투자를 통해 에이아이 데이터센터를 구축할 예정이다. 연관 산업까지 20여만개 일자리가 생길 것으로 예상한다. 강원도 산업 지도를 다시 그리겠다. 영동 지역은 물과 전기가 풍부하다. 강릉이야말로 대규모 에이아이 데이터센터가 들어설 최적지다.”)

―Candidate Kim demands that you disclose the company's name? (―김 후보는 기업명을 공개하라고 요구하는데?)

"I will disclose it after the election. Political figures, including current Governor Kim, have touted attracting Tesla or Samsung semiconductor plants to Gangwon, but most have not materialized. Residents, weary of accumulated disappointment, have lost trust in the political sphere's pledges. That's why I announced it after discussions, only when the attraction was confirmed." (“선거 뒤에 공개하겠다. 현직 지사인 김 후보 등 정치권이 테슬라나 삼성 반도체 공장 강원도 유치를 내걸고도 대부분 현실화하지 않았다. 실망이 누적된 도민들이 정치권의 공약을 신뢰하지 못하고 있다. 그래서 유치가 확정될 때까지 논의한 뒤 발표한 것이다.”)

―You are a four-term National Assembly member, but you have operated in Seoul. There is criticism that you lack understanding of the region. (―4선 국회의원이지만 서울에서 활동했다. 지역에 대한 이해도가 낮다는 비판이 있다.)

"If someone knows Gangwon, they should have done well. Gangwon Province is seeing 4,000 young people outflow annually, and has experienced negative growth for two consecutive years. Large-scale investment in new industries is essential, but there are no such achievements at all. People Power Party candidates seem to be clinging to regional ties, as the government and ruling party check argument doesn't work and they have no achievements to boast of." (“강원을 아는 사람이면 잘했어야 한다. 강원도는 연간 청년 4천명씩 유출되고, 최근 2년 연속 마이너스 성장을 했다. 대대적인 신규 산업 투자가 필수적인데 이런 성과가 전혀 없다. 국민의힘 후보들이 정부·여당 견제론은 안 먹히고 내세울 성과도 없으니 지역 연고론에 매달리는 것 같다.”)

―Is there a possibility of a late-stage consolidation of the conservative base? (―보수층이 막판 결집할 가능성은?)

"At the launch, we formed a large-scale, 2,130-member conservative and progressive integrated election campaign committee. Not only the organizations of former Governors Lee Kwang-jae and Choi Moon-soon, but also former lawmaker Yeom Dong-yeol from the conservative camp and former Deputy Governor for Political Affairs Choi Heung-jip joined with their respective organizations. This is because Gangwon Province is regressing too much, leaving no room to worry about factions. Even if the conservative support base consolidates, its scale is expected to be limited." (“출범 당시 2130명 대규모의 보수·진보 통합 선거대책위원회를 꾸렸다. 이광재 전 지사와 최문순 전 지사 조직은 물론이고, 보수 진영의 염동열 전 의원과 최흥집 전 정무부지사도 각자의 조직과 함께 합류했다. 진영 따질 여유가 없이 강원도가 너무 후퇴하고 있어서다. 보수 지지층 결집해도 규모는 제한적일 것으로 예상한다.”)

―If elected, what would be the first thing you do? (―당선된다면 가장 먼저 할 일은?)

"The central government provided support funds for high oil prices through a supplementary budget, but additional support is needed in Gangwon. Due to high oil prices, fishermen are unable to launch their boats. The situation for small business owners and farmers is also dire. Immediately upon taking office, I will review the financial situation, arrange additional emergency funds, and devise an emergency economic plan. I feel a sense of crisis that the Republic of Korea cannot exist without preventing regional extinction. I want to give hope to the residents." (“중앙정부가 추경 편성을 통해 고유가 지원금을 지급했지만 강원도에선 추가 지원이 필요하다. 고유가로 어민들은 배를 못 띄우고 있다. 중소상공인들과 농민들의 사정도 다급하다. 취임 즉시 재정상황을 살펴보고 긴급 지원금을 추가로 마련해 비상경제 플랜을 짤 것이다. 지방 소멸을 막지 않고는 대한민국이 존재할 수 없을 것 같단 위기의식을 느꼈다. 도민들에게 희망을 드리고 싶다.”)

By Choi Ha-yan and Ko Kyung-joo, staff reporters chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 고경주 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Fact Check] The claim of a supply disruption for 30,000 housing units in Seoul is closer to a potential impact zone. ([팩트체크] 서울 3만가구 공급차질론, 잠재적 영향권 가까워)
item.description:
Ahead of the Seoul mayoral election, the issue of 'relocation cost loans' for redevelopment and reconstruction projects has emerged as a key real estate policy debate. The camp of Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, argues that government loan regulations could disrupt supply for 31,000 housing units in redevelopment sites. In contrast, the camp of Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate, counters that the scale of damage presented by the Seoul Metropolitan Government is exaggerated. We examined the core issue centered on how redevelopment sites scheduled for relocation can secure relocation costs. (서울시장 선거를 앞두고 재개발·재건축 정비사업의 ‘이주비 대출’ 문제가 부동산 정책 쟁점으로 떠올랐다. 오세훈 국민의힘 후보 쪽은 정부의 대출 규제로 정비사업 현장에서 3만1천호 규모의 공급 차질이 우려된다고 주장한다. 반면 정원오 더불어민주당 후보 쪽은 서울시가 제시한 피해 규모가 실제보다 넓게 잡혔다며 맞서고 있다. 이주에 들어갈 정비사업장들이 이주비를 어떻게 마련할 수 있는지를 중심으로 쟁점을 따져봤다.)

① Is it true that loan regulations will disrupt supply for 31,000 housing units? (①대출규제로 3만1천호 공급 차질, 사실일까?)

It’s close to a half-truth. Last January, the Seoul Metropolitan Government announced that out of 43 redevelopment projects slated for relocation this year, 39—about 31,000 housing units—are affected by loan regulations. Under regulated areas, a loan-to-value (LTV) ratio of 40% applies for one-homeowners, and 0% for multi-homeowners for relocation loans. According to the city, this could make it difficult for union members to vacate their existing homes or return deposits to tenants. However, it's hard to interpret this figure as “31,000 housing units have halted relocation due to loan regulations.” In fact, the list released by Seoul includes not only sites that have received management disposition approval, the step just before relocation, but also early-stage sites still preparing for management disposition, awaiting project implementation approval, or undergoing building reviews. In redevelopment projects, relocation typically takes several months or more after the management disposition approval. The 31,000 housing units are closer to a 'potential impact zone'—those that could be affected in the future—rather than an actually delayed volume. (절반의 사실에 가깝다. 서울시는 지난 1월 올해 이주 예정 정비사업 43곳 중 39곳, 약 3만1천호가 대출 규제 영향권에 있다고 밝혔다. 규제 지역 기준 1주택자 이주비 대출은 주택담보인정비율(LTV) 40%, 다주택자는 0%가 적용된다. 이 때문에 조합원들이 기존 집을 비우거나 세입자 보증금을 돌려주는 데 어려움을 겪을 수 있다는 게 서울시 설명이다. 다만 이 수치를 곧바로 “3만1천호 이주가 대출 규제로 멈췄다”고 보기는 어렵다. 실제 서울시가 공개한 명단에는 이주 직전 단계인 관리처분인가를 받은 곳뿐만 아니라, 아직 관리처분을 준비 중이거나 사업시행인가, 건축심의를 받는 초기 단계 사업장까지 섞여 있다. 정비사업은 통상 관리처분인가 뒤에도 실제 이주까지 수개월 이상 걸린다. 3만1천호는 실제 지연 물량이라기보다 앞으로 영향을 받을 수 있는 ‘잠재적 영향권’에 가깝다.)

② Is the claim that “union members with two or more homes won’t receive a single won in relocation loans” true? (②“2주택 이상 조합원 이주비 한 푼도 못 받아” 주장, 사실일까?)

It’s true if considering only personal loans, but it’s exaggerated because the issue can be resolved through other means. Multi-homeowner union members face an LTV of 0%, limiting personal relocation loans. However, there is a separate way to handle returning deposits to tenants. Under Article 70 of the Urban and Residential Environment Improvement Act, if a tenant demands the direct return of their deposit from the union, the union can pay first and later claim it from the respective union member. In this case, the funds raised by the union are classified as 'project cost loans' for the redevelopment project, not personal mortgage loans. In other words, the issue can be resolved at the union level by utilizing guarantees from the Housing and Urban Guarantee Corporation (HUG). (개인 대출만 보면 사실이지만, 다른 방법으로 문제를 풀 수 있다는 점에서 과장이다. 다주택 조합원은 주택담보인정비율 0%가 적용돼 개인 명의 이주비 대출이 제한된다. 그러나 세입자에게 보증금을 돌려주는 문제는 따로 해결할 수 있는 길이 열려 있다. 도시정비법 제70조에 따라 세입자가 조합에 직접 보증금을 돌려달라고 요구하면, 조합이 먼저 돈을 내주고 나중에 해당 조합원에게 청구할 수 있다. 이때 조합이 조달하는 자금은 개인이 빌리는 주택담보대출이 아니라, 재개발 사업을 위한 ‘사업비 대출’로 분류된다. 즉, 주택도시보증공사(HUG)의 보증을 활용해 조합 차원에서 문제를 해결할 수 있다는 뜻이다.)

However, this method is not perfect. In areas that have already received management disposition approval, the total project cost and HUG guarantee limits are often fixed. To increase project costs or change line items later, general meetings must be reconvened or approvals must be reobtained. (다만 이 방식도 만능은 아니다. 이미 관리처분인가를 받은 구역은 총사업비와 주택도시보증공사 보증 한도가 정해진 경우가 많아, 뒤늦게 사업비를 늘리거나 비목을 바꾸려면 총회를 다시 열거나 심사를 다시 받아야 한다.)

③ Is the expansion of Seoul’s Housing Promotion Fund by 100 billion won effective? (③서울시 주택진흥기금 1천억원 확대, 실효성 있나?)

It’s more of a complementary measure. Candidate Oh stated, “To address the delayed relocation of complexes due to the government’s loan restrictions, we are considering supporting relocation costs through Seoul’s Housing Promotion Fund” and proposed expanding the fund by 100 billion won. The aim is to use Seoul’s own financial resources to unclog the supply pipeline. However, the city’s fund support is closer to selective assistance targeting small-to-medium-sized redevelopment unions with 500 or fewer members. Assuming a maximum support of 300 million won per person, the 100 billion won could cover only a few hundred individuals by simple calculation. This is insufficient to handle the entire 31,000 housing units that Seoul identified as being within the potential impact zone. (보완책 성격이 강하다. 오 후보는 “정부의 대출 제한으로 이주가 지연되는 단지들을 위해 서울시 주택진흥기금을 통한 이주비 지원을 강구하고 있다”며 주택진흥기금 1천억원 확대를 내세웠다. 막힌 공급의 혈관을 서울시 자체 재원으로 뚫겠다는 취지다. 그러나 서울시 기금 지원은 조합원 500명 이하 중소규모 정비사업 조합을 대상으로 한 선별 지원에 가깝다. 1인당 최대 3억원을 지원한다고 가정하면 1천억원으로 지원 가능한 인원은 단순 계산으로 수백명 수준이다. 서울시가 영향권으로 제시한 3만1천호 전체를 감당하기에는 부족하다.)

Reporter Shin Hyeong-cheol newiron@hani.co.kr (신형철 기자 newiron@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Min-shik and Han Dong-hoon Call Each Other "Traitors"…Ha Jung-woo Says "Take Your Bickering to Seoul" (박민식-한동훈 서로 “배신자”…하정우 “쌈박질은 서울서”)
item.description:
On the 21st, the first day of official campaigning for the June 3 by-elections for the National Assembly, attention was focused on candidate unification variables in Busan North Gap and Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul, with both districts heating up from the start. In North Gap, tensions flared among conservative camp candidates, while in Pyeongtaek-eul, fierce exchanges unfolded between candidates from the Democratic and progressive camps. (6·3 국회의원 재보궐선거 공식 선거운동이 시작된 21일, 후보 단일화 변수에 관심이 쏠리는 부산 북갑과 경기 평택을은 첫날부터 뜨겁게 달아올랐다. 북갑은 보수 진영 후보들 사이의 신경전이, 평택을은 민주·진보 진영 후보들 사이의 공방이 치열하게 전개됐다.)

At the Busan North Gap by-election, Ha Jung-woo of the Democratic Party of Korea, Park Min-shik of the People Power Party, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon attended a "Bean Noodle Sharing Event" at the Namsan Comprehensive Social Welfare Center in Buk-gu that morning. All three candidates wore smiles, but tension hung in the air. (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 하정우 더불어민주당 후보와 박민식 국민의힘 후보, 한동훈 무소속 후보는 이날 오전 북구 남산정종합사회복지관에서 열린 ‘콩국수 나눔 행사’에 참석했다. 세 후보 모두 웃는 얼굴이었지만 긴장감이 흘렀다.)

After the event, Park and Han clashed head-on over conservative voter support. "Han is someone who inflicted an indelible wound on the conservative camp and should beg for forgiveness," Park told reporters, directly attacking Han as committing "an act of betrayal against conservative supporters." That afternoon, Park shaved his head, declaring, "I will not unify with traitor Han Dong-hoon." (행사 이후 박 후보와 한 후보가 보수 진영 표심을 두고 정면충돌했다. 박 후보는 기자들과 만나 “한 후보는 보수 진영에 씻을 수 없는 상처를 준 사람으로 석고대죄해야 한다”며 “보수 지지자들에 대한 배신 행위”라고 직격했다. 박 후보는 이날 오후 “배신자 한동훈과 단일화하지 않겠다”며 삭발을 했다.)

In response, Han retorted, "Is he talking about how he himself betrayed (Busan North-gu) and left?" and added, "If you betrayed Busan, I wish you'd just stay quiet." Ha, at his campaign launch, criticized both Park and Han, saying, "What politics, ideology, or faction does the name Buk-gu have? If you want to fight, go do it in Seoul." (한 후보는 박 후보의 발언에 대해 “본인이 (부산 북구를) 배신하고 떠난 거 말씀하시는 건가?”라고 되물으며 “부산을 배신했으면 좀 가만히 계셨으면 좋겠다”고 맞받았다. 하 후보는 이날 출정식에서 “북구라는 이름에 무슨 정치고 이념이고 정파가 어디 있느냐. 쌈박질하려면 서울 가서 하라”며 박 후보, 한 후보를 모두 비판했다.)

The race in Busan North Gap shows Ha and Han in a tight contest, with Park trailing in pursuit. According to a poll commissioned by the JoongAng Ilbo and conducted by K-Stat Research via wireless phone interviews from the 17th to the 19th, Ha had 35%, Han 31%, and Park 20%. In hypothetical two-way matchups, Ha led Park 41% to 32%, and Ha and Han were tied at 38% each. (부산 북갑 판세는 하 후보와 한 후보가 접전을 벌이고 박 후보가 추격하는 흐름이다. 지난 17~19일 중앙일보가 케이스탯리서치에 의뢰해 무선 전화면접을 통해 한 여론조사 결과를 보면 하 후보 35%, 한 후보 31%, 박 후보 20%로 조사됐다. 양자 대결에서는 하 후보 41% 대 박 후보 32%, 하 후보 38% 대 한 후보 38%였다.)

In Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul, where a by-election for the National Assembly is being held, five candidates crisscrossed the area on the 21st, heating up the region. Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party of Korea, at his campaign launch at Anjung Market, directly criticized Cho Kuk of the Fatherland Innovation Party—often mentioned as a potential presidential contender—and Yoo Ui-dong of the People Power Party, a three-term lawmaker from Pyeongtaek. "I have no intention of jumping into the presidential race right after being elected like some people, nor will I serve without any results like another candidate who has been in office for three terms," Kim said. (국회의원 재선거가 치러지는 경기 평택을은 이날 5명의 후보가 곳곳을 누비며 지역을 뜨겁게 달궜다. 김용남 더불어민주당 후보는 안중시장 출정식에서 “저는 누구처럼 당선되자마자 대선 주자로 뛸 생각도 없고, 또 어떤 후보처럼 3선을 했는데도 아무 성과 없이 보내지도 않겠다”고 잠재적 대선 주자로 불리는 조국 조국혁신당 후보와 평택에서 3선 국회의원을 한 유의동 국민의힘 후보를 직격했다.)

Cho Kuk held his campaign launch at the planned site for the KTX Gyeongnam Southern Station in Haechang-ri, urging voters to "choose the person, not the party this time" and emphasized his role as a representative of the democratic and reformist camp. "Once I take office in the National Assembly, I will immediately act to unite and integrate the democratic and progressive forces," he said. (조 후보는 해창리 케이티엑스(KTX) 경기남부역 예정지에서 출정식을 열고 “이번에는 정당이 아니라 인물을 선택해달라”며 “국회에 등원하면 민주·개혁 진영의 연대와 통합을 위해 바로 행동에 나서겠다”고 자신이 민주·진보 진영을 대표한다고 강조했다.)

Yoo Ui-dong, also at Anjung Market, took aim at Kim and Cho, who lack local ties. "Can you trust the pledges of someone who has lived in Pyeongtaek for less than a month?" he said. (유 후보는 안중시장 출정식에서 “평택에 살아본 지 한달도 채 안 된 분이 내놓는 공약을 신뢰할 수 있겠는가”라며 지역 연고가 없는 김 후보, 조 후보와 각을 세웠다.)

In Pyeongtaek-eul, Kim, Cho, and Yoo are forming a three-way race, with unification seen as a late-stage variable. In a poll conducted by Korea Research for MBC (via phone interviews from the 16th to the 18th), Kim stood at 31%, Cho at 27%, Yoo at 17%, Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Freedom and Innovation Party at 7%, and Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party at 2%. (For details, refer to the website of the Central Election Survey Deliberation Commission.) (평택을에선 김 후보와 조 후보, 유 후보가 3자 구도를 형성하고 있는데 단일화가 막판 변수로 꼽힌다. 문화방송(MBC) 의뢰로 코리아리서치가 지난 16∼18일 실시한 여론조사(전화면접 조사)에서 김 후보는 31%, 조 후보는 27%, 유 후보는 17%, 황교안 자유와혁신 후보는 7%, 김재연 진보당 후보는 2%를 기록했다.(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조))

Jang Narae Reporter wing@hani.co.kr Ko Hansol Reporter sol@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr 고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: OPCON Transfer Possible as Early as Late 2027…"Decision at the Political Level" (전작권 전환 이르면 2027년 말 가능…“정치적 수준에서 결정”)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense has predicted that the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) could be achieved by late 2027 if consultations between South Korea and the United States proceed smoothly. (국방부가 한국과 미국 간 협의가 원활하게 진행되면 2027년 말께 전시작전통제권(전작권) 환수가 가능할 것이라고 전망했다.)

A defense ministry official told reporters on the 20th regarding the OPCON transfer, "The roadmap will be completed before the (upcoming late October ROK-U.S. defense ministers' meeting) Security Consultative Meeting (SCM), and based on that roadmap, we will prepare for the OPCON transition and the period thereafter." The official added, "The original goal was to complete the roadmap at the first half ROK-U.S. Integrated Defense Dialogue (KIDD) held on the 12th and 13th, but it's been delayed because we have more content to include in the roadmap." (국방부 관계자는 지난 20일 기자들과 만난 자리에서 전작권 환수와 관련해 “(오는 10월 말 한-미 국방장관 회담인) 한-미 연례안보협의회의(SCM) 이전에는 로드맵이 완성되고, 이 로드맵을 기준으로 전작권 전환 및 전작권 전환 이후에 대한 부분을 준비(하겠다)”고 말했다. 그는 “원래는 지난 12~13일 열린 전반기 한-미 국방통합협의체(KIDD)에서 로드맵 완성을 목표로 했는데 우리가 (로드맵에) 담아야 할 내용이 좀 더 많아서 지연되고 있다”며 이같이 말했다.)

South Korea and the United States are currently conducting the evaluation and verification of the mission capability of the future Combined Forces Command, which will replace the ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command after the OPCON transfer, in three stages. (한국과 미국은 현재 전작권 전환 뒤 한미연합사령부를 대신할 미래연합군사령부의 임무수행능력 평가·검증을 3단계로 나눠 진행하고 있다.)

The two countries completed the first stage, Initial Operational Capability (IOC) evaluation (2019) and verification (2020), and conducted the second stage, Full Operational Capability (FOC) evaluation (2022). Plans are to verify this at this year's annual ROK-U.S. Security Consultative Meeting. Once verification is complete, the ROK and U.S. defense ministers will decide the year for the OPCON transfer and recommend it to the two countries' presidents. Subsequently, the ROK and U.S. defense ministers will immediately complete the third stage, Full Mission Capability (FMC) evaluation and verification, and then recommend a transfer date to the ROK and U.S. presidents. (두 나라는 1단계인 기본운용능력(IOC) 평가(2019년)와 검증(2020년)을 마쳤고, 2단계인 완전운용능력(FOC) 평가(2022년)를 했다. 올해 한-미 연례안보협의회의에서 이를 검증할 계획이다. 검증이 끝나면 한·미 국방장관은 전작권 전환 연도(×년도)를 결정하고 두 나라 대통령에게 건의한다. 이후 한·미 국방장관은 곧바로 3단계인 완전임무수행능력(FMC) 평가·검증까지 마친 뒤 한·미 대통령에게 전환 일자를 건의한다.)

It is known that once the year for OPCON transfer is set, a preparation period of one year is sufficient. (전작권 전환 연도가 정해지면 준비 기간은 1년이면 충분한 것으로 알려졌다.)

If the ROK and U.S. defense ministers propose 2027 as the target year for OPCON transfer at this October's ROK-U.S. Security Consultative Meeting and finalize the process within a year, it would be possible to suggest a specific date within 2027 for the transfer at the October 2027 ROK-U.S. SCM. This would be before the end of U.S. President Donald Trump's term (January 20, 2029). (한·미 국방장관이 올 10월 한-미 연례안보협의회의에서 2027년을 전작권 전환 목표 연도로 제시하고 1년 만에 절차를 마무리하면 2027년 10월 한-미 연례안보협의회의에서 2027년 안에 날을 정해 전환 일자로 건의하는 것이 가능하다. 이는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령 임기 종료(2029년 1월20일) 전이다.)

However, this timeline is a wish of South Korea. U.S. Forces Korea Commander General Xavier Brunson stated at a House Armed Services Committee hearing last month regarding the OPCON transfer, "Political expediency should not outpace conditions." This emphasizes that meeting the conditions agreed upon by the two countries for OPCON transfer is more important than the timing. Commander Brunson suggested the OPCON transfer timeline as the first quarter (January-March) of 2029, which could include after President Trump's term. (다만 이 일정은 한국의 희망 사항이다. 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관은 지난달 미 하원 군사위원회 청문회에서 전작권 전환과 관련해 “정치적 편의주의가 조건을 앞질러서는 안 된다”고 밝혔다. 시기가 아니라 한·미가 합의한 전작권 전환 조건 충족이 중요하다는 것이다. 브런슨 사령관은 전작권 전환 시기를 트럼프 대통령 임기 이후를 포함한 2029년 1분기(1~3월)로 제시했다.)

A defense ministry official said, "The OPCON transfer is an issue determined at the policy and political level from start to finish." This implies that the OPCON transfer is ultimately a political decision by the presidents of South Korea and the United States. (국방부 관계자는 “전작권 전환은 시작부터 끝까지 정책적, 정치적 수준에서 결정되는 사안”이라고 말했다. 전작권 전환은 결국 한·미 두 나라 대통령의 정치적 결정이란 것이다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party proposes amendment to May 18 Special Act… "Defamation and insulting acts also to be punished" (민주당, 5·18특별법 개정안 발의…“명예 훼손·모욕 행위도 처벌”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea proposed an amendment to the "May 18 Special Act" (Partial Amendment to the Special Act on the May 18 Democratization Movement and Related Matters) on the 21st, which expands the scope of punishment to include acts that defame or insult the honor of the victims and their families of the May 18 Democratization Movement. (더불어민주당이 5·18 민주화운동 희생자와 유족의 명예를 훼손하거나 모욕하는 행위도 처벌 대상으로 삼는 ‘5·18특별법 개정안’(5·18민주화운동 등에 관한 특별법 일부개정법률안)을 21일 발의했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun issued a written briefing on the same day, stating, "The May 18 movement is once again becoming the target of ridicule and insult, as if the fact that just three days ago was the 46th anniversary of the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement is being overshadowed." He added, "No matter the intent or method, any act of disrespecting the May 18 movement will be met with stern punishment and severe penalties," announcing the proposal of the special act. (강준현 수석대변인은 이날 서면브리핑을 내어 “불과 3일 전이 5·18광주민주화운동 제46주년이었던 사실이 무색할 정도로 5·18이 또다시 조롱과 모욕의 대상이 되고 있다”며 “어떤 의도와 방식이든 5·18을 모독하는 행위에는 처절한 응징과 엄벌로 다스릴 것”이라고 특별법 발의 사실을 알렸다.)

The amendment proposed by the Democratic Party on this day expands on the existing punishment for spreading false information about the May 18 Democratization Movement, and now includes acts that defame or insult the honor of the victims, their families, and related individuals of the May 18 movement within the scope of punishment. (이날 민주당이 발의한 5·18특별법 개정안은 기존 5·18민주화운동에 관한 허위사실 유포에 대해서 처벌하던 것을 확대해 5·18운동 희생자와 유족, 관련자의 명예를 훼손하거나 모욕하는 행위도 처벌 대상에 포함하는 내용이 담겼다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang said, "Strictly speaking, the fact that we have to push for such legislation is itself lamentable," adding, "This is because, even without resorting to legislation, disrespecting the May 18 movement is something that common sense dictates should absolutely not be done." (강 수석대변인은 “엄밀히 말하면 이러한 입법을 추진하는 상황 자체가 한탄스러운 일”이라며 “굳이 법률로 다루지 않더라도 5·18을 모독하는 일은 지극히 해선 안 되는 상식이기 때문”이라고 했다.)

Kang further noted, "The May 18 insult marketing by Starbucks, the largest domestic coffee chain brand, is escalating beyond shock into public outrage as time goes on." He added, "Yesterday (the 20th), an audio recording was released of People Power Party floor leader Song Un-seok saying the reason he doesn’t visit Gwangju for the May 18 anniversary is because it’s 'dirty.' He then gave a flimsy excuse that he meant 'sorrowful,' and even after the recording was made public, he didn’t leave a single word of apology to the people and the spirits of Gwangju." (이어 강 수석대변인은 “국내 최대 커피 전문 브랜드인 스타벅스의 5·18 모욕 마케팅은 시간이 갈수록 충격을 넘어 국민적 분노로 이어지고 있다”며 “5·18에 광주를 방문하지 않는 이유를 ‘더러버서’라고 말한 송언석 원내대표의 육성 녹취가 어제(20일) 공개됐다. 이것을 ‘서러워서’라고 표현했다며 어설픈 변명으로 일관한 것도 모자라, 녹취가 공개됐음에도 국민과 광주의 영령 앞에 사과 한마디 남기지 않았다”고 했다.)

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Xi Jinping Likely to Visit North Korea as Early as Next Week, Possibly Discussing US-North Korea Summit and North Korean Nuclear Issue (시진핑, 이르면 다음주 방북…북미회담·북핵 등 논의 할 듯)
item.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping is highly likely to make a state visit to North Korea as early as next week, as reported on the 21st. (시진핑 중국 국가주석이 이르면 다음주 북한을 국빈 방문할 가능성이 큰 것으로 21일 알려졌다.)

A senior government official told The Hankyoreh on the same day, "President Xi Jinping is expected to visit North Korea soon." If Xi visits North Korea, it would be the first time in seven years since his initial visit in June 2019. It has been reported that a Chinese security team and protocol team recently traveled to Pyongyang. U.S. news magazine Time also reported on the 20th (local time), citing an anonymous source, that "President Xi may visit North Korea next week." (정부 고위 당국자는 이날 한겨레에 “시진핑 주석이 곧 북한을 방문할 것으로 보인다”고 말했다. 시 주석이 방북하면 2019년 6월 첫 방북 뒤 7년 만이다. 최근 중국 경호팀과 의전팀은 평양을 다녀온 것으로 전해졌다. 미국 시사주간지 타임도 20일(현지시각) 익명의 소식통을 인용해 “시 주석이 다음주 북한을 방문할 가능성이 있다”고 보도했다.)

The visit of Wang Yi, Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission and Foreign Minister of the Chinese Communist Party, to North Korea last month for the first time in six years and seven months also lends weight to the possibility of Xi's visit. Wang visited Pyongyang from April 9-10 and met with North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un. Chairman Kim told Wang, "Let us continue to deeply develop the North Korea-China friendly cooperation relations centered on socialism and strengthen high-level exchanges." (지난달 왕이 중국공산당 중앙외사판공실 주임 겸 외교부장이 6년7개월 만에 방북한 것도 시 주석 방북 가능성에 힘을 싣는다. 왕 부장은 4월9~10일 평양을 방문해 김정은 북한 국무위원장과 만났다. 김 위원장은 왕 부장에게 “중국과 함께 사회주의를 핵심으로 하는 조-중 우호협력 관계를 계속 심도 있게 발전시키고 고위급 교류를 강화하자”고 말했다.)

If Xi's visit to North Korea materializes, North Korea-China relations are expected to become even more solid. Last year, Chairman Kim attended the 80th anniversary of Victory Day celebrations held in Beijing, China. This year marks the 65th anniversary of the signing of the "North Korea-China Friendship Cooperation Treaty." Given that Xi held US-China and China-Russia summit meetings on the 14th and 20th respectively, discussions on US-North Korea relations and Korean Peninsula issues are anticipated. (시 주석의 방북이 이뤄질 경우 북-중 관계는 더욱 공고해질 전망이다. 지난해 김 위원장은 중국 베이징에서 열린 전승절 80주년 기념식에 참석했다. 올해는 ‘중조우호협력호조조약’(북중우호조약) 체결 65주년이다. 시 주석이 지난 14일과 20일 각각 미-중, 중-러 정상회담을 했다는 점에서 북-미 관계와 한반도 문제에 관한 대화도 나눌 것으로 전망된다.)

The Blue House stated, "The government is monitoring related developments," adding, "The government hopes that exchanges between North Korea and China will take place in a way that contributes to peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula, and expects China to play a constructive role in matters related to the Korean Peninsula." (청와대는 “정부는 관련 동향을 주시하고 있다”며 “정부는 북-중 간 교류가 한반도 평화와 안정에 기여하는 방향으로 이루어지기를 희망하며, 중국이 한반도 문제와 관련해 건설적인 역할을 해나가길 기대한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Won-oh Sweeps Gangnam and Han River Belt, Oh Se-hoon Launches 'Whirlwind' Campaign Across Gangnam-buk and Jongno (정원오는 강남·한강벨트 훑고, 오세훈 강남북·종로 ‘회오리’ 유세)
item.description:
On the 21st, the first day of official campaigning for the June 3 local elections, candidates in the biggest battleground—the Seoul mayoral race—began their final 13-day push by targeting vulnerable areas. Jung Won-oh of the Democratic Party of Korea focused on the Han River belt (districts adjacent to the Han River), including Gangnam, while Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party launched a 'whirlwind' campaign starting in the Gangbuk area, sweeping through the southwest, Jongno, and Gangnam. Minority party candidates worked to boost their presence. (6·3 지방선거 공식 선거운동이 시작된 21일, 최대 격전지인 서울시장 선거에 나선 후보들은 취약 지역을 훑으며 13일간의 막판 총력전을 시작했다. 정원오 더불어민주당 후보는 강남 지역을 포함한 한강벨트(한강 근접 자치구)를 공략했고, 오세훈 국민의힘 후보는 강북 지역에서 시작해 서남부와 종로, 강남까지 도는 ‘회오리’ 유세에 나섰다. 소수 야당 후보들은 존재감 부각에 힘썼다.)

At midnight on the first day of official campaigning, Jung kicked off his campaign at the Dongseoul Postal Distribution Center in Gwangjin-gu, meeting parcel delivery workers and helping sort packages. Party leader Chung Cheong-rae also lent a hand. Jung said, "I hear campaign materials are delivered to homes through this center," adding, "I chose to come here to thank you for your hard work on our behalf." (정 후보는 공식 선거운동이 시작된 이날 0시, 광진구 동서울우편집중국을 찾아 택배 노동자를 만난 뒤 소포 분류 작업을 돕는 것으로 첫 유세를 시작했다. 이 자리에는 정청래 대표 등도 손을 보탰다. 정 후보는 “선거 홍보물이 이곳을 통해 가정으로 전달된다고 한다”며 “저희 때문에 고생하시기에 감사를 전하려 (이곳을) 택했다”고 했다.)

Afterward, Jung held a launch ceremony at Wangsimni Station in Seongdong-gu, his political home, alongside 25 district office chief candidates. In the afternoon, he signed a joint agreement with candidates from the four Gangnam districts to promote "early reading and AI education city policies," then continued street campaigns at the Seocho Bus Terminal and Gangnam Square on Teheran-ro in Gangnam-gu, focusing on winning over the Gangnam area, considered a weak spot. A campaign official said, "This expresses his intent to reaffirm his image as a competent local leader and spread the achievements of Seongdong-gu's administration." (정 후보는 이후 자신의 정치적 고향인 성동구 왕십리역에서 25곳 자치구청장 후보들과 함께 출정식을 열었다. 오후에는 강남4구 구청장 후보들과 ‘조기독서·에이아이(AI·인공지능)교육도시 공동정책’ 추진 협약식을 맺고 서초구 고속버스터미널, 강남구 테헤란로 강남스퀘어에서 거리 유세를 이어가는 등 취약 지역으로 분류되는 강남권 민심 공략에 집중했다. 캠프 관계자는 “일 잘하는 지자체장으로서의 면모를 (강남4구에) 다시금 확인시키고 성동구정의 성과를 확산시키겠다는 의지의 표현”이라고 했다.)

Jung also visited the underground fifth-floor construction site of the GTX-A line near Samsung Station in Gangnam-gu, where a rebar omission controversy has arisen, to inspect internal cracks. At the launch ceremony, he appealed, "If you want a safety-first, safe Seoul, not a safety-apathetic Seoul, please vote for Jung Won-oh." (정 후보는 철근 누락 논란이 불거진 강남구 삼성역 수도권광역급행철도(GTX)-에이(A) 노선 지하 5층 공사 현장을 찾아 내부 균열 상태를 살피기도 했다. 그는 출정식에서 “안전 불감증 서울시가 아니라 안전최고주의 안전한 서울 원하시면 정원오에 투표해달라”고 호소했다.)

Starting his first event at midnight at the Garak Market vegetable auction hall in Songpa-gu, Oh wore a raincoat to deliver a "message to the public" in the alleys of Mia-dong, Gangbuk-gu, where he spent his childhood. Oh said, "By easing height restrictions near Bukhansan and offering floor area ratio incentives, 35 housing redevelopment projects are progressing in Gangbuk-gu," adding, "I chose this starting point because solving the housing issues that ordinary people care about began right here." Former lawmaker Yoo Seong-min joined him, but no party leadership members appeared. (이날 0시 송파구 가락시장 채소경매장에서 첫 일정을 시작한 오 후보는 유년기를 보낸 강북구 미아동 주택가 골목길에서 우비를 입은 채 ‘출정 대시민 메시지’를 발표했다. 오 후보는 “북한산 인근 고도제한을 풀고 용적률 인센티브를 줘서 강북구에서 주택정비사업장 35곳이 진도가 나가고 있다”며 “서민들이 관심을 갖는 주거 문제 해결이 바로 이곳에서 시작됐기 때문에 출발지로 선택했다”고 했다. 유승민 전 의원이 함께했고, 당 지도부 의원들은 모습을 드러내지 않았다.)

Oh then expanded his outreach by visiting Inwang Market in Seodaemun-gu, Woo-ri Market in Yeongdeungpo-gu, and Nanguro Market in Guro-gu. His launch ceremony was held at Cheonggye Plaza in Jongno-gu. At Inwang Market, Oh emphasized his four-term tenure as Seoul mayor, saying, "Cooking rice may seem simple, but only those who have actually cooked it know how to avoid undercooked or overcooked rice." An official from Oh's camp explained, "Oh's intention is to divide Seoul into four zones and tour each one without neglecting any area." (이어 오 후보는 서대문구 인왕시장, 영등포구 우리시장, 구로구 남구로시장을 돌며 시민들과 접촉면을 넓혔다. 출정식은 종로구 청계광장에서 열었다. 오 후보는 인왕시장 유세에서 “밥하는 거 간단해 보이지만 밥을 해본 사람이 선밥, 진밥 안 만든다”며 4선 서울시장을 지낸 이력을 강조했다. 오 후보 캠프 관계자는 “서울을 4개 권역으로 나눠 한 바퀴를 돌면서 어느 한곳도 소외되지 않게 하겠다는 오 후보의 뜻이 담겨 있다”고 했다.)

Minor party candidates also went all out. Kim Jung-chul, the Reform Party candidate for Seoul mayor, held a launch ceremony at Exit 7 of Sadang Station alongside party leader Lee Jun-seok. Kwon Young-guk of the Justice Party rode the first bus of route 6411—mentioned in a speech by the late lawmaker Roh Hoe-chan—starting at 3:20 a.m., arriving at Sinjeong Depot around 5 a.m. to meet subway workers as they dispatched the first train, appealing for their support. (소수당 후보들도 총력전에 나섰다. 김정철 개혁신당 서울시장 후보는 이날 오후 이준석 대표와 함께 사당역 7번 출구에서 출정식을 열었다. 권영국 정의당 후보는 새벽 3시20분 고 노회찬 의원의 연설에서 언급된 6411번 버스 첫차를 타고 새벽 5시께 신정 차량기지에 도착해 지하철 첫차를 출발시키는 지하철 노동자들을 만나며 표심을 호소했다.)

Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae and People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk focused on winning over central region voters. After stops in Dongjak-gu, Seoul, and Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi Province, Chung emphasized "judging the insurrection" in Daejeon, Gongju, and Cheonan in South Chungcheong Province. Jang highlighted "judging the administration" in Daejeon, Gongju, and Asan in South Chungcheong Province. item.title: President Lee Says "Arrest Netanyahu," But Israel Sends Message of Hope for "Developing Relations" (이 대통령 “네타냐후 체포” 발언에도, 이스라엘 “관계 발전 희망” 메시지)
item.description:
Although President Lee Jae-myung strongly criticized Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as a "war criminal" after Israeli forces seized Korean activists participating in the Gaza aid flotilla, Israel appears to be focusing on managing bilateral relations rather than mounting a direct confrontation. This response is seen as taking into account the bilateral relationship and the growing international criticism of Israel's actions. <<> According to a summary from the presidential office and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the 21st, Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated through diplomatic channels that it "hopes this issue will not affect Korea-Israel relations and that they will develop further." The two Korean activists were released via deportation without being held in detention facilities. They are set to return to South Korea on the 22nd. <<> The "issue" referred to by Israel is interpreted as encompassing both the detention and subsequent release of two Korean nationals aboard the Gaza aid ship on the 18th and the previous day (20th), as well as President Lee's critical remarks regarding Israel. In a cabinet meeting the previous day, President Lee stated that "detaining our citizens for reasons not valid under international law is too harsh and inhumane," and, referring to Benjamin Netanyahu, the Israeli Prime Minister for whom the International Criminal Court (ICC) has issued an arrest warrant, as a "war criminal," instructed officials to consider executing the arrest warrant. <<> President Lee's strong message raised concerns in diplomatic circles about the potential for strained Korea-Israel relations. However, instead of directly responding, Israel chose to convey its views through diplomatic channels, focusing the content on the friendly relationship between the two countries. This shows a difference in temperature compared to the reaction last month when President Lee shared a video criticizing Israel on X. At that time, Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs released a rebuttal stating the president's actions were "unacceptable." <<> There is analysis that Israel's changed response has been influenced by the international criticism pouring in over the Gaza aid flotilla issue. This is because a video has been released showing Itamar Ben-Gvir, Israel's far-right National Security Minister, forcing activists detained by Israeli forces to kneel and press their heads to the ground, saying, "Welcome to Israel. We are the masters of this land," sparking controversy. Criticism is growing, with over 20 countries condemning Israel's actions. <<> Nevertheless, Israel's stance on the Gaza issue remains firm. The Israeli Embassy in South Korea issued a statement on the 21st, asserting that the "Gaza aid flotilla" is "not humanitarian in nature, but a provocation aimed at attacking Israel and diverting it from its mission of fighting terrorism." The Israeli Embassy emphasized its legality, stating, "This flotilla, which also carried South Korean nationals, is an attempt to undermine U.S. President Donald Trump's peace efforts in the region," and that "Israel is enforcing a legal maritime blockade on the Gaza Strip." It also added, "The authority to intercept (aid ships) on the high seas stems from the Law of Naval Warfare as specified in international documents. The Law of Naval Warfare establishes the right to intercept vessels attempting to violate a blockade on the high seas." <<> In the previous day's cabinet meeting, President Lee pointed out regarding the high seas in the Mediterranean where the aid ship was intercepted, "Is that Israeli territorial waters?" and "If there is an engagement, can a third-country ship be seized and the people taken?" A Ministry of Foreign Affairs official stated regarding the president's remarks, "We need to conduct an international legal review." <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 가자구호선단에 참여한 한국인 활동가들이 이스라엘군에 나포된 뒤 베냐민 네타냐후 총리를 향해 ‘전범’으로 지칭하며 강하게 비판 했지만, 이스라엘은 정면 대응 대신 양국 관계 관리에 초점을 두는 모습이다. 양국 관계를 고려한 것과 더불어 이스라엘의 행동에 대한 국제적 비판이 거세지는 것을 염두에 둔 대응이라는 해석이 나온다.)

item.title: Xi Jinping, after Trump and Putin, turns to Kim Jong-un… Strategic move for 'Korean Peninsula mediator' initiative (시진핑, 트럼프·푸틴 이어 김정은까지…‘한반도 중재자' 주도권 포석)
item.description:
With speculation rising about Chinese President Xi Jinping's potential visit to North Korea, attention is focused on what conversations he might have with North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un if the visit occurs. Notably, since President Xi held US-China and China-Russia summit meetings just a week apart, it is anticipated that he will share relevant details and exchange views on issues such as North Korea-US dialogue, the North Korean nuclear issue, and matters concerning the Korean Peninsula. The South Korean government is paying close attention, viewing President Xi's visit to North Korea as a possible opportunity to ease strained inter-Korean relations. (시진핑 중국 국가주석의 북한 방문 가능성이 거론되면서, 방북이 이뤄질 경우 김정은 북한 국무위원장과 어떤 대화를 나눌지 관심이 모인다. 특히 시 주석이 최근 일주일 간격으로 미-중, 중-러 정상회담을 한 터라 관련 내용을 공유하고, 북-미 대화나 북핵, 한반도 문제 등에 대한 의견을 나눌 것이라는 전망이 나온다. 정부는 시 주석 방북이 남북관계 경색을 푸는 계기가 될 수 있다고 보고 주목하고 있다.)

Several recent signals have added weight to the possibility of President Xi's visit to North Korea. In March, North Korea and China resumed bidirectional passenger train services between Beijing and Pyongyang for the first time in six years. Air flights between Pyongyang and Beijing have also resumed. Notably, last month, Wang Yi, Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission of the Chinese Communist Party and Foreign Minister, visited North Korea for the first time in six years and seven months. (시 주석 방북에 무게를 실을 만한 신호는 최근 여럿 있었다. 북·중은 지난 3월 중국 베이징과 북한 평양을 잇는 양방향 여객열차 운행을 6년 만에 재개했다. 평양~베이징 간 항공 운항도 재개됐다. 특히 지난달에는 왕이 중국공산당 중앙외사판공실 주임 겸 외교부장이 6년7개월 만에 방북했다.)

If President Xi visits North Korea, it would serve as a return visit for Chairman Kim's attendance at the 80th anniversary of China's Victory Day last September. Additionally, this year marks the 65th anniversary of the signing of the "China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation, and Mutual Assistance" (North Korea-China Friendship Treaty), making it a symbolic event to emphasize North Korea-China friendship. During his visit to North Korea last month, Minister Wang Yi emphasized strengthening high-level exchanges and communication to North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui, stating that it "shows that the traditional blood-tied friendship between China and North Korea will never fade or be broken." For President Xi, following the South Korea-China summit with President Lee Jae-myung in January and the US-China and China-Russia summits in May, concluding a North Korea-China summit would solidify China's leadership in Korean Peninsula diplomacy. (시 주석이 방북하면 지난해 9월 김 위원장의 중국 전승절 80주년 행사 참석에 대한 답방 성격을 띠게 된다. 특히 올해가 ‘중-조 우호협력호조조약’(북-중 우호조약) 체결 65주년인 까닭에 북-중 우의를 강조하는 상징적인 이벤트가 될 수 있다. 지난달 방북한 왕이 부장은 최선희 북한 외무상에게 “피로 맺어진 중·조의 전통적 우의가 영원히 퇴색되지 않고 깨뜨릴 수 없음을 보여줬다”며 고위급 교류 소통 강화를 강조했다. 시 주석으로서는 1월 이재명 대통령과의 한-중 정상회담과 5월 미-중, 중-러 정상회담에 이어 북-중 정상회담까지 마무리하면 중국이 한반도 외교의 주도권을 쥐고 있다는 것을 확고히 할 수 있다.)

Agenda items could include not only North Korea-China relations but also North Korea-US talks and the North Korean nuclear issue. (의제로는 북-중 관계뿐 아니라 북-미 회담, 북핵 문제 등이 오를 수 있다.)

Following their summit in Beijing on May 14-15, President Xi and US President Donald Trump stated that they "confirmed the common goal of denuclearizing North Korea." In particular, President Trump said he had discussed North Korea with President Xi. (시 주석과 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 지난 14~15일 중국 베이징에서 정상회담을 한 뒤 “북한 비핵화라는 공동의 목표를 확인했다”고 말했다. 특히 트럼프 대통령은 시 주석과 북한에 대해 논의했다고도 했다.)

The South Korean government is watching closely to see if a breakthrough in the chilled inter-Korean relations might emerge. The Lee Jae-myung administration has been making efforts to improve inter-Korean relations, but North Korea has kept its doors closed by formally adopting a "two-state" stance toward the South. However, on May 17, North Korea sent its women's soccer team to the South. (우리 정부는 냉각된 남북관계의 돌파구가 열릴지 관심을 기울이고 있다. 이재명 정부는 남북관계 개선에 공을 들이고 있지만 북한은 남북 두 국가론을 공식화하며 문을 열지 않고 있다. 다만 북한은 지난 17일 내고향여자축구단을 남쪽에 보냈다.)

Professor Moon Il-hyun of China University of Political Science and Law told The Hankyoreh that "President Xi could serve as a messenger, conveying messages that President Lee or President Trump want to deliver to North Korea." (문일현 중국 정법대 교수는 한겨레에 “시 주석이 이 대통령이나 트럼프 대통령이 북한에 전달하고픈 내용을 전달하는 메신저 구실을 할 수 있을 것”이라고 말했다.)

On May 21, regarding the possibility of President Xi's visit to North Korea, Minister of Unification Chung Dong-young said, "There's been no announcement from China yet, so we'll wait and see," but added, "In the face of the shifting tectonic plates of Northeast Asian geopolitics surrounding the Korean Peninsula, it's time for deep strategic consideration of stability, peace, and shared prosperity on the Peninsula." When asked if a North Korea-US dialogue would be discussed if President Xi visits North Korea, Minister Chung responded, "It would naturally be discussed," adding that "massive tectonic plates are turning." A government official stated, "It's still cautious, but with limited changes like North Korea sending its women's soccer team, we are expecting shifts in the situation." (정동영 통일부 장관은 21일 시 주석의 방북 가능성에 관해 “아직 중국 발표가 없어 좀 지켜보겠다”면서도 “한반도를 둘러싼 동북아 정세의 지각변동 앞에서 한반도의 안정, 평화, 공동번영을 전략적으로 깊이 고민해야 할 때”라고 말했다. 정 장관은 ‘시 주석이 방북한다면 북-미 대화가 논의될 것 같냐’는 물음에 “당연히 논의될 것”이라며 “거대한 지각판이 돌아가고 있다”고 말했다. 정부 관계자는 “아직 조심스럽지만 북한의 여자축구팀 파견 등 제한적인 변화가 나타나고 있는 만큼 상황 변화를 기대하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Cho Han-bum, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, said, "This visit to North Korea appears aimed at strengthening China's influence in inter-Korean relations by capitalizing on waning US attention to the Korean Peninsula issue due to conflicts like the war in Iran," adding, "Given that President Lee's relationship with President Xi is not bad, and North Korea has sent its women's soccer team, there is a possibility of China-facilitated improvement in inter-Korean relations." (조한범 통일연구원 석좌연구위원은 “이란 전쟁 등으로 한반도 문제에 대한 미국의 관심이 줄어드는 틈을 파고들어 중국이 남북관계에서 영향력을 강화하는 차원의 방북으로 보인다”며 “이 대통령과 시 주석의 관계가 나쁘지 않고, 북한도 여자축구팀을 보내는 상황에서 중국발 남북관계 개선 가능성도 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporters Seo Young-ji and Jang Ye-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 장예지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.description:
The official campaign for the June 3 local elections kicked off at midnight on May 21. From the very first day, the messages delivered by the leaders of the two major parties were markedly different. Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae kicked off his schedule in Seoul with candidate Jeong Won-oh, placing emphasis on the Seoul metropolitan area contest. In contrast, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, at the "Daejeon Citizens' Victory Rally" at Daejeon Station, said, "The only way to restart the presidential trial is for the People Power Party to win this local election," focusing his firepower on a full-scale offensive against the ruling party. <<> The most eye-catching battleground is the Busan North Gap by-election. In a survey conducted by Research & Research for Channel A from the 17th to the 19th, independent candidate Han Dong-hoon garnered 34.6%, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo 32.9%, and People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik 20.5%. Assuming conservative consolidation, Ha Jung-woo versus Han Dong-hoon showed 37.6% to 44.1%, with Han ahead. The survey was conducted via wireless telephone interviews targeting 500 voters in the Busan North Gap district. As the election approaches, the trend of conservative votes shifting toward Han Dong-hoon is becoming evident, and calls for unification are growing louder. <<> In the Seoul mayoral race, the controversy over missing rebar in the GTX-A project has emerged as a major late-stage variable. The original ordering agency, the Korea National Railway, and the commissioned ordering agency, the Seoul Metropolitan Government, are in direct conflict over responsibility for the omission of rebar in the GTX-A Samsung Station section. The Seoul city government stated it reported the missing rebar to the Korea National Railway three times, but the railway agency countered that it was only mentioned in parts of the voluminous monthly construction management reports and work logs, with no formal report or separate consultation. People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon’s camp has filed a complaint with police against officials from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, among others, on charges of violating the Public Official Election Act. <<> Where will the messages and routes delivered on the first day of the official campaign steer the dynamics over the remaining 13 days? Is the true goal of the People Power Party leadership the victory of the conservatives, or the defeat of Han Dong-hoon? To what extent should the Seoul mayor take responsibility for deficiencies in large-scale construction projects directly linked to citizen safety? We explore these questions on . item.title: First Day of Election Campaign: Seoul Mayoral Candidates Target Voter Sentiment from Dawn [Manlija Photo Series] (선거운동 첫날, 서울시장 후보들…새벽부터 표심 공략 [만리재사진첩])
item.description:
The full-scale curtain has risen for the June 3 nationwide local elections and parliamentary by-elections. Major candidates, including Jeong Won-o of the Democratic Party, Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party, and Kwon Young-guk of the Justice Party, began meeting voters en masse at midnight and dawn on the 21st, the start of the official campaign period. Thereafter, each candidate traversed every corner of Seoul throughout the day, focusing on their weak areas or themes they wished to appeal to voters, urging them for their votes. (6·3 전국동시지방선거와 국회의원 재보궐선거의 본격적인 막이 올랐다. 정원오 더불어민주당, 오세훈 국민의힘, 권영국 정의당 후보 등 주요후보들은 선거운동이 가능한 21일 자정과 새벽에 맞춰 일제히 유권자들을 만나기 시작했다. 이후 각 후보들은 자신의 취약지역이나 유권자들에게 호소하고 싶은 주제에 맞춰 하루종일 서울 구석구석을 돌며 유권자들에게 한표를 호소했다.)

Candidate Jeong Won-o kicked off his campaign at midnight at the Dong Seoul Post Office in Gwangjin District with a delivery item campaign. During the day, he toured Konkuk University Station in Seongdong District along the Han River and Gangnam District, and in the evening, he wrapped up his first day with street greetings at Gangnam Square. Notably, he revisited the construction site of the Gangnam Underground Shopping Center near Samsung Station in Seoul, which has recently been embroiled in controversy over missing rebar, to appeal to citizens about safety. (정원오 후보는 21일 자정 광진구 동서울우편집중국에서 택배물품 선거운동을 시작해, 낮에는 한강을 끼고 있는 성동구의 건대입구역과 강남구를 돌고 저녁에는 강남스퀘어에서 거리인사를 하며 첫날 선거운동을 마무리했다. 특히 최근 철근 누락으로 논란이 되고 있는 서울 삼성역 강남지하상가 공사현장을 다시 찾아 안전에 대해 시민들에게 호소했다.)

Candidate Oh Se-hoon began his campaign at dawn by visiting the Garak-dong Agricultural and Marine Products Wholesale Market in Seoul, carrying cabbages. He then toured Seoul's northwestern and southwestern areas, such as Seodaemun, Yeongdeungpo, and Guro districts—classified as his weak regions—to appeal for votes. In the evening, he held a campaign launch rally at Cheonggye Plaza in Jongno. (오세훈 후보는 이날 새벽 서울 가락동 농수산물도매시작을 찾아 배추를 나르며 선거운동을 시작했다. 이후 본인의 취약지역으로 분류되는 서울 서대문구, 영등포구, 구로구 등 서울 서북과 서남지역을 돌며 한표를 호소했다. 이후 저녁에는 종로 청계광장에서 캠프 출정식을 열었다.)

Candidate Kwon Young-guk started his official campaign at midnight at Guro Digital Complex Station by greeting waste collection workers. He then boarded the first bus of route 6411, greeted subway workers at Sinjeong Vehicle Depot, visited the Dongja-dong ghetto village, and concluded his day with a campaign rally in Yeonnam-dong, Mapo District, in the evening. (권영국 후보는 21일 자정 구로디지털단지역에서 쓰레기 수거 노동자들과 인사를 시작으로 본격 선거운동을 시작했다. 이후 6411번 버스 첫차 탑승, 신정차량기지에서 지하철 노동자 인사, 동자동 쪽방촌 방문 등의 일정을 이어간 뒤 저녁에 마포구 연남동에서 출정식을 하며 하루 일정을 마무리했다.)

item.title: President Lee Orders "Thorough Inspection" of Missing Rebar at Samsung Station… People Power Party Fiercely Criticizes as "Election Interference by the Government" (이 대통령 “삼성역 철근 누락 철저 점검”… 국힘 “관권 선거” 강력 반발)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung has ordered a strict fact-finding investigation into the missing rebar incident at the Samsung Station construction section of the Great Train Express (GTX)-A, which has emerged as a key issue in the Seoul mayoral election for the June 3 local elections. The People Power Party strongly reacted, calling it "blatant election interference by the government" in support of Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea's Seoul mayoral candidate. (이재명 대통령이 6·3 지방선거 서울시장 선거 쟁점으로 떠오른 수도권광역급행철도(GTX)-에이(A) 삼성역 공사 구간 철근 누락 사태에 관해 엄정한 실태 파악을 지시했다. 국민의힘은 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보를 편드는 “노골적 관권 선거”라고 강하게 반발했다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong explained at a briefing at the presidential office on the 21st, "President Lee has ordered the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety to conduct a strict fact-finding and thorough safety inspection," adding, "Considering the summer rainy season and future conditions, the government has a responsibility and duty to ensure on-site safety to prevent major accidents." Following President Lee's directive, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety announced that they have formed a government joint inspection team, involving specialized agencies like the Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency and external experts, to conduct a safety inspection of the GTX Samsung Station section starting today. <<> Candidate Jeong and Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party's Seoul mayoral candidate, are locked in a dispute over 2,570 rebar pieces (totaling 178 tons) that were missing from the concrete pillars of the GTX Samsung Station construction section. The Seoul Metropolitan Government is under suspicion of covering up the issue because it was aware of the missing rebar since November last year but only reported it to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport at the end of last month. Candidate Jeong is attacking, saying that during Mayor Oh Se-hoon's tenure, the city neglected oversight, ignoring public safety. In response, Candidate Oh claims he reported the issue to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and argues that Jeong is spreading falsehoods. <<> Following President Lee's remarks, the People Power Party reacted strongly. <<> Candidate Oh wrote on Facebook, "Since President Lee Jae-myung has already started election interference by the government, Candidate Jeong Won-oh should no longer hide and come forward directly to debate (this issue)." Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk also wrote on Facebook, "This is blatant election interference." Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon criticized, "The President has forgotten his duty and touted himself as the 'Senior Election Strategy Committee Chairman of the Democratic Party,' making the public angry." <<> On the 14th, a day after President Lee's visit to Moran Market in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok said, "They are engaging in blatant election interference by the government," and warned, "If President Lee's electioneering proceeds just one more time, we will immediately pursue legal action." <<> Reporters Shim Woo-sam and Jang Na-rae wu32@hani.co.kr ( 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 21일 청와대 브리핑에서 “이 대통령이 국토교통부와 행정안전부 등에 엄정한 실태 파악과 철저한 안전점검을 지시했다”며 “여름철 우기와 앞으로의 상황 점검을 봤을 때, 대형 안전사고 방지 차원에서 현장의 안전을 살필 정부로서 책임과 의무가 있다”고 설명했다. 이 대통령의 지시에 국토교통부와 행정안전부는 한국산업안전보건공단 등 전문기관과 외부 전문가가 참여하는 정부합동점검단을 꾸려 이날부터 지티엑스 삼성역 구간에 안전점검을 실시한다고 발표했다.)

item.title: President Lee Jae-myung Visits Donui-dong Jjokbang Village to Examine Conditions of Vulnerable Groups (이재명 대통령, 돈의동 쪽방촌 찾아 취약계층 여건 점검)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung visited Donui-dong jjokbang village in Jongno-gu, Seoul, on the 21st to inspect the living conditions of vulnerable groups ahead of summer torrential rains and heatwaves. (이재명 대통령이 21일 서울 종로구 돈의동 쪽방촌을 찾아 여름철 집중호우와 폭염을 앞두고 취약 계층의 생활 여건을 점검했다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung said in a written briefing that day, “The President visited Donui-dong jjokbang village in Seoul this afternoon to listen to the opinions of officials and residents.” ( 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑을 통해 “이 대통령은 오늘 오후 서울 돈의동 쪽방촌을 방문해 관계자와 주민들의 의견을 청취했다”고 했다. )

Residents greeted him, saying, “Since this neighborhood was established, a president has come for the first time,” and “Thank you for coming all the way here.” It was reported that the President exchanged handshakes and hugs with the residents. ( 주민들은 “이 동네 생기고 대통령이 처음 왔다”, “여기까지 와줘서 고맙다”며 인사를 건넸고, 이 대통령은 주민들과 악수와 포옹을 하며 인사를 나눴다고 한다.)

The day before, President Lee had instructed in a Cabinet meeting that on-site inspections and support measures be prepared for vulnerable groups, including jjokbang village residents, elderly people living alone, and outdoor workers. ( 이 대통령은 전날 국무회의에서 쪽방촌 주민과 독거노인, 옥외노동자 등 취약계층에 대한 현장 점검, 지원 대책 마련을 지시한 바 있다. )

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr ( 고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)
